tokens.name: nx-blue
tokens.usage: Nexus Blue (Pantone Process Blue C), the brand's dominant accent. Graphics only on light grounds: bars, selection marks, the sidebar rule, switch tracks, focus ring source. 3.2:1 on white, so never small text there; text uses `accent-text`.

tokens.name: nx-t20
tokens.usage: Nexus Blue tint 20. Chart and schedule fills, never text.

tokens.name: nx-t40
tokens.usage: Nexus Blue tint 40. Chart and schedule fills (hold bars), never text.

tokens.name: nx-t70
tokens.usage: Nexus Blue tint 70. Chart fills, never text.

tokens.name: nx-d20
tokens.usage: Nexus Blue shade 20. Chart fills; 4.1:1 on white, large text or graphics only.

tokens.name: nx-d40
tokens.usage: Nexus Blue shade 40. Source of `accent-text`, `primary-bg` and `info` in light; 5.9:1 on white.

tokens.name: nx-d60
tokens.usage: Nexus Blue shade 60. Source of `accent-hover` and `primary-hover` in light; milestone marks.

tokens.name: nx-bluegray
tokens.usage: Brand Blue Gray. Quiet graphics and the internal-audience mark. Text uses `text-2` (the brand value is 3.9:1 on white).

tokens.name: nx-lightgray
tokens.usage: Brand Light Gray. Source of `surface-3`.

tokens.name: nx-darkgray
tokens.usage: Brand Dark Gray. Source of `text` (8.1:1 on white).

tokens.name: nx-g1
tokens.usage: Brand grey shade 1. Decorative fills only.

tokens.name: nx-g2
tokens.usage: Brand grey shade 2. Decorative fills only.

tokens.name: nx-g3
tokens.usage: Brand grey shade 3. Decorative fills only.

tokens.name: nx-orange
tokens.usage: Brand tertiary orange. Fill for warnings and the today marker; `warn` carries warning text.

tokens.name: nx-green
tokens.usage: Brand tertiary green. Fill for success marks; `ok` carries success text.

tokens.name: nx-lightblue
tokens.usage: Brand tertiary light blue. Action links on the dark toast.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page canvas behind everything. Text reads on it at `text` and `text-2`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, dialogs, menus. Same as `bg` in light; one step lighter than `bg` in dark.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Quiet bands: the side bar, summary strips, disabled inputs, button hover.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Table headers, segmented-control tracks, chips, hover on quiet surfaces.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs and the mobile side-bar drawer.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between regions. Decorative, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Row rules inside tables and lists, one step quieter than `line`.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and button borders. 1.7:1 on white, below the 3:1 non-text floor; a known miss inherited from the Scheduler, softened by the `focus` ring and hover border (`text-3`). Do not use it to carry meaning alone.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-2`. 8.1:1 on white.

tokens.name: text-strong
tokens.usage: Titles, row names and emphasized values on `bg` and `surface`.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels and metadata on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-2`. 5.0:1 on white. Derived from Blue Gray. On `surface-3` (default chip and header fill) it is 4.3:1 in light, a known miss inherited from the Scheduler; use `text` there when the words matter.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled text, quiet icons and nav group headings. 3.0:1 on white (a known miss), so never for text a person must read; pair with a visible label.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label or icon on a solid `accent` fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Indicators: focus outline, selected marks, bars, active nav rule. Graphics only; use `accent-text` for text.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and accent-colored text on `bg` and `surface`. 5.9:1 on white; 6.6:1 on `bg` in dark.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of links and accent text.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active nav item, pressed toggles (Nexus Blue at 10%). `text-strong` reads on it.

tokens.name: accent-softer
tokens.usage: Hover tint on rows and list items.

tokens.name: primary-bg
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. `primary-fg` reads on it.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill.

tokens.name: primary-fg
tokens.usage: Label on `primary-bg` and `primary-hover`.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Notices that are not alarms: icon and text on `info-bg`, banner rule.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Info banner and chip background.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on `warn-bg`, `bg` and `surface`. Derived from the brand orange (4.9:1 on white).

tokens.name: warn-fill
tokens.usage: Warning fills and rules: banner rule, count badge, today marker. Dark text sits on it.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Warning banner and chip background.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on `ok-bg`, `bg` and `surface`. Derived from the brand green (5.1:1 on white).

tokens.name: ok-fill
tokens.usage: Success fills and marks.

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: Success chip background.

tokens.name: crit
tokens.usage: Errors, conflicts and destructive actions: text, icons, danger-button fill. The only red in the system; not in the brand palette. White text on the light danger button is 5.4:1.

tokens.name: crit-bg
tokens.usage: Error banner and chip background.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Lato for reading and controls; Roboto Condensed (family `cond`) for headings, labels, numbers and anything tabular. Weights 400 and 700 only.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text for the whole Toolbox.

groups.name: Condensed
groups.note: Headings, labels and numbers. Numbers always use tabular figures.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow and form labels (`.lbl`, `.eyebrow`). Form field labels are 12px with .06em tracking.

styles.name: number
styles.usage: Project numbers, dates and counts (`.num`), tabular figures.

tokens.name: fs-xs
tokens.usage: Chips, kbd, counts, nav group headings.

tokens.name: fs-sm
tokens.usage: Hints, metadata, small buttons.

tokens.name: fs-md
tokens.usage: Body text and controls.

tokens.name: fs-lg
tokens.usage: Large body, big row titles.

tokens.name: fs-xl
tokens.usage: Dialog and section headings.

tokens.name: fs-2xl
tokens.usage: Page titles.

spacing.note: 4px grid. Off-grid values (5px, 6px, 10px, 14px) exist inside the component rules where the Scheduler uses them; new work stays on the grid.

tokens.name: s1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight stacks.

tokens.name: s2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls and button rows.

tokens.name: s3
tokens.usage: Between related fields.

tokens.name: s4
tokens.usage: Card padding, mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: s5
tokens.usage: Default `.pad`.

tokens.name: s6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: s8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter (`.phead`, `.pbody`).

tokens.name: s10
tokens.usage: Large separations, empty states.

radius.note: Chips and avatars are pills or discs; they set their own radius.

tokens.name: r1
tokens.usage: kbd keys, mini bars.

tokens.name: r2
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items, menu items.

tokens.name: r3
tokens.usage: Menus, cards, segmented control, toast.

tokens.name: r4
tokens.usage: Dialogs and empty-state boxes.

tokens.name: ctl-h
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, inputs, selects and segmented controls. Small is 28px, large 38px.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: Table and timeline row height. 27px in dense mode (`body.dense`).

tokens.name: side-w
tokens.usage: Side navigation width. 60px when collapsed (`body.side-collapsed`).

shadow.note: Two elevations and a focus ring. Dark shadows are heavier because they sit on dark surfaces.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Raised option in a segmented control.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs, drawers and toasts. Nothing else floats.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Soft halo on a focused text field, paired with an `accent` border. Keyboard focus elsewhere uses a 2px `accent` outline.
